goalieCandidate.probability: Player gamesStarted sum for that date set / number of dates in the set, or zero when no dates
goalieCandidate.inference: This implementation can emit probability 1 with confirmed_status false. The documented 09:30 UTC label is consistent with the six previously captured October 1 rows at 09:30:06Z, but does not prove which execution/version wrote them or the historical screenshot.
